# Kuwahara (painterly)

An edge-preserving smoothing filter that turns detail into flat, brushy patches, like an oil painting: each pixel takes the calmest neighboring region’s average.

<EffectDemo effect="kuwahara" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { kuwahara } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/kuwahara';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(kuwahara({ preset: 'oil' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.radius = 4`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter                | Type              | Default   | Range    | Description                                                                         |
| ------------------------ | ----------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `radius`                 | number            | `4`       | 1 – 8 px | Size of the regions; larger makes bigger strokes and costs more.                    |
| `sectors` _(structural)_ | 'four' \| 'eight' | `'eight'` |          | Four square quadrants (classic, blockier) or eight soft sectors (smoother strokes). |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                       |
| --------- | ------------------------------ |
| `oil`     | `radius: 6`                    |
| `classic` | `sectors: 'four'`, `radius: 5` |
| `subtle`  | `radius: 2`                    |
| `heavy`   | `radius: 8`                    |

Apply one with `kuwahara({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/kuwahara`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Kuwahara et al., Processing of RI-angiocardiographic images, 1976; Papari, Petkov and Campisi, Artistic edge and corner enhancing smoothing, 2007 (generalized sector filter).

## Related

- [Watercolor](./watercolor) — Paints the image in watercolor: soft washes that bleed and waver, darker rims where pigment pools, and grain where it settles into the paper.
- [Toon posterize](./posterize) — Flattens brightness into a few bands while keeping each color’s hue, and darkens edges, for a cartoon look on any image.
- [Mosaic & stained glass](./mosaic) — Breaks the image into irregular cells (a Voronoi mosaic), each filled with one color and outlined in lead, like stained glass or tiles.
